{{short description|American chemist}}
'''Ruth Wexler''' is an American industrial chemist best known as a co-discoverer of [[apixaban]], a marketed anticoagulant; and [[losartan]], a blood pressure treatment.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=https://cen.acs.org/articles/93/i9/E-B-Hershberg-Award-Important.html|title=E. B. Hershberg Award For Important Discoveries In Medicinally Active Substances {{!}} Chemical & Engineering News|last=Jarvis|first=Lisa|website=cen.acs.org|access-date=2018-11-21}}</ref>

== Education ==
Wexler received her B.A. in chemistry from [[Boston University]] in 1977, and a Ph.D. in organic chemistry working with [[Amos Smith|Amos B. Smith]] at the [[University of Pennsylvania]] in 1982.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.acsmedchem.org/?nd=Wexler|title=Ruth R. Wexler, Ph.D.|website=www.acsmedchem.org|access-date=2018-11-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sas.upenn.edu/smith-group/content/wexler-ruth|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150908005258/http://www.sas.upenn.edu/smith-group/content/wexler-ruth|url-status=dead|archive-date=September 8, 2015|title=Wexler, Ruth {{!}} Amos Smith Research Group|website=www.sas.upenn.edu|language=en|access-date=2018-11-21}}</ref>

== Research ==
Wexler started her career at [[DuPont]] in 1982, rising to Executive Director in 1998. She then joined [[Bristol-Myers Squibb]] as an Executive Director in 2001, moving eventually to New Jersey to head their cardiovascular research unit.<ref name=":1" /> She has worked on targets involved in apoptosis, inflammation, obesity, and coagulation. As of 2018, she has over 215 original research publications.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Quan|first=Mimi L.|last2=Pinto|first2=Donald J. P.|last3=Smallheer|first3=Joanne M.|last4=Ewing|first4=William R.|last5=Rossi|first5=Karen A.|last6=Luettgen|first6=Joseph M.|last7=Seiffert|first7=Dietmar A.|last8=Wexler|first8=Ruth R.|date=2018-05-18|title=Factor XIa Inhibitors as New Anticoagulants|journal=Journal of Medicinal Chemistry|language=en|volume=61|issue=17|pages=7425–7447|doi=10.1021/acs.jmedchem.8b00173|pmid=29775297|issn=0022-2623}}</ref>

== Awards ==

* 2015 - [[E.B. Hershberg]] Award for Discoveries in Medicinally Active Substances<ref name=":0" />
* 2014 - Inducted into the ACS MEDI Hall of Fame<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.acsmedchem.org/?nd=inductees|title=MEDI Hall of Fame Inductees|website=www.acsmedchem.org|access-date=2018-11-21}}</ref>
* 2011 - BMS Ondetti and Cushman Award
* 2004 - Outstanding New Jersey Woman in Research
